subject: [PATCH] kernfs: allocate in open before taking the active reference

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of kernfs by allocating memory for open files and their associated seq_file structures before taking an active reference to the file. This change reduces the time spent waiting for reclaim operations, particularly in scenarios where cgroup operations are performed concurrently. The patch also ensures that if a file is removed while being opened, the operation fails with -ENODEV as expected.
